name: Meimon Joshikou Ryokou ~Ore Dake Otoko Nandesu ga!?~
original_name: 名門女子校旅行 ～俺だけ男なんですが!?～
source:
Inside the train station on a clear, sunny day.

"Hello~"

Unfamiliar greetings echoed here and there.
Groups of young ladies chatted excitedly about their plans, their voices light and cheerful.
It was the start of a three-night, four-day school trip for the Canary Girls’ Academy, a chance to experience the culture of the Kanto region.
Their itinerary was packed—churches, temples, amusement parks—all visited without a care for consistency.
The protagonist, Azabu Reiji, had been roped into going on this trip in place of his sister… while cross-dressing as her.
When will they find out?
With that thought weighing heavily on his mind, Reiji boarded the bullet train, feeling utterly miserable.
But to his surprise, no one seemed to notice. They all treated him as if he were his sister, striking up conversations without a second thought.
And, being the opportunist he was, Reiji started to relax. The all-girls environment began to feel… oddly pleasant.
Surrounded by sweet scents and the soft, refined chatter of the girls, he let out a small sigh of relief. His tense expression softened just a bit.

"……Reiji?"

Standing in front of him was the student council president, Kousaka Maki.
I’m done for!
And so, Reiji found himself stuck in a girls’ school trip, cross-dressing and surrounded by young ladies for three nights and four days.
A trip filled with constant heart-pounding moments!?

[Translated from [url=http://www.t-apricot.jp/cherry/meimon/story/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
晴朗的日子里，车站内部。

“你好～”

陌生的问候声此起彼伏。
一群群大小姐兴奋地聊着计划，声音轻快而愉悦。

金丝雀女子学院三晚四天的修学旅行开始了，这是体验关东地区文化的机会。行程安排得满满当当：教堂、寺庙、游乐园，全都要去，完全不考虑连贯性。

主人公麻布礼司被拉来代替妹妹参加旅行……而且还要女装成妹妹。

他们什么时候会发现？

这个念头沉重地压在心头，礼司登上新干线，感到无比痛苦。

但令他惊讶的是，似乎没人注意到。他们把他当成妹妹，毫不犹豫地搭话聊天。

而礼司向来善于抓住机会，也开始放松下来。全是女孩的环境竟然……出奇地令人愉快。

甜美的香气与女孩柔和优雅的交谈声环绕着他，他轻轻松了口气，紧绷的表情也稍稍柔和。

“……礼司？”

站在他面前的是学生会长高坂真希。

完了！

就这样，礼司被困在女子学校的修学旅行中，女装并被大小姐们包围三晚四天。

这会是一场心跳不断的旅行吗！？
